description:
Role: PLC/BMS Developer 
 Location: Bloomfield, CT 
 Duration: 4 to 12 Months 
 Mode of hire: Contract to hire (only W2) 
 Rate: Competitive 
 
 
 
 PLC programmer to interface PLC sensors to Building Management Systems (BMS). This person would program/install sensors to capture and report on information regarding the maintenance of a building (pipe pressures, temperature readings, sensing wetness … 
 
 
 
 Description of Work: 
 We need to supplement our data with data residing in existing building management systems (BMS).
Conceptual designs of interfacing HSB sensor systems to PLCs and building BMS systems
Interface HSB sensors to Client PLC Systems
Interface HSB sensors to Client BMS Systems
Training of HSB personnel
 

 
 
 Primary Skill Required: 
 Discipline in PLC languages such as Function Block Diagram, Ladder diagram, STL, and Structured Text


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
